commands.command: cargo clippy -- -D warnings -D unsafe_code -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::expect_used -D clippy::panic -D clippy::todo -D clippy::unimplemented -D clippy::dbg_macro -D clippy::indexing_slicing -D clippy::as_conversions

rules_satisfied: Power of Ten Rule 1: Simple control flow - no recursion, no panic-driven control flow
Power of Ten Rule 2: Fixed loop bounds - iterates over a bounded slice
Power of Ten Rule 5: Invariant density - checked_add for overflow, is_empty guard
Power of Ten Rule 7: Checked returns - every fallible result is handled
Zero forbidden constructs - no unsafe, unwrap, expect, panic, todo, unimplemented, unreachable
No unchecked indexing or unchecked arithmetic
No lossy as conversions - uses u64::from, u64::try_from, u32::try_from
Panic-free production code - all error paths return typed errors
skipped_gates: cargo audit - not a workspace with dependencies
cargo deny check - no dependency policy
residual_risk: No residual risk. All 3 tests pass. Clippy clean with strict Holzman Rust lints. No forbidden constructs remain. The fix replaced unchecked arithmetic (sum += *value) with checked_add, added empty-slice guard, and replaced lossy as conversions with safe from/try_from methods.
